sources: Canonical166 actual captured first sources, reverse ONLY exact first mutation to pinned base; every actual compiled snapshot checked before export. Replay derives every declared phase mutation from archived canonical text and compares all snapshot hashes.
models_expectations: Archive all canonical pinned models/generators, exact first/remaining/baseline plans, GO contents, actual runners and their hashed dependencies.
logs: Retain first and remaining terminal records/resource/cap/journal logs and all phase evidence; baseline23 original-bench receipts/logs retained separately.
portability: Exported replay.py uses only Python standard library and relative archive files. No original /tmp worktrees, Git, installed compiler, binaries, checkpoint or external tool required for --verify.
first_dependency: Fresh remaining GO exact reviewed-first status and record/service/closure hashes verified against archived first run.
success_and_failure: Terminal PASS requires all3 exact fatal closures. Terminal FAIL stays FAIL; incomplete phases receive no qualification. No changed expectation or retry.
binary_scope: No binary replay or deleted generated-content rehash claim; generated inventory and binary pre-reclamation hash provenance only.
publication: Parent review/intake then export and commit terminal archive and replay receipt as added main evidence. Preparation alone is not runtime PASS.
